```text
diff --git a/packages/excalidraw/components/Pages.tsx b/packages/excalidraw/components/Pages.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..d71f18c9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/excalidraw/components/Pages.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,170 @@
+import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+
+import { isNonDeletedElement } from "@excalidraw/element";
+
+import { exportToCanvas } from "../scene/export";
+
+import { getDefaultAppState } from "../appState";
+import { t } from "../i18n";
+
+import "./Pages.scss";
+
+import type { BinaryFiles, UIAppState } from "../types";
+import type { DrawingPage } from "../pages";
+
+const PAGE_PREVIEW_WIDTH = 144;
+const PAGE_PREVIEW_HEIGHT = 96;
+
+const PageIcon = () => (
+  <svg
+    aria-hidden="true"
+    width="20"
+    height="20"
+    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
+    fill="none"
+    stroke="currentColor"
+    strokeWidth="1.5"
+    strokeLinecap="round"
+    strokeLinejoin="round"
+  >
+    <rect x="4" y="3" width="16" height="18" rx="2" />
+    <path d="M8 8h8M8 12h8M8 16h5" />
+  </svg>
+);
+
+const PagePreview = React.memo(
+  ({
+    page,
+    files,
+    appState,
+  }: {
+    page: DrawingPage;
+    files: BinaryFiles;
+    appState: UIAppState;
+  }) => {
+    const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
+
+    useEffect(() => {
+      let active = true;
+      const elements = page.elements.filter(isNonDeletedElement);
+
+      if (!elements.length) {
+        setPreviewUrl(null);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => {
+        const defaultAppState = getDefaultAppState();
+        const previewAppState = {
+          ...defaultAppState,
+          ...appState,
+          ...page.settings,
+          width: appState.width,
+          height: appState.height,
+          offsetTop: 0,
+          offsetLeft: 0,
+          scrollX: 0,
+          scrollY: 0,
+          zoom: defaultAppState.zoom,
+        };
+
+        void exportToCanvas(
+          elements,
+          previewAppState,
+          files,
+          {
+            exportBackground: true,
+            exportPadding: 8,
+            viewBackgroundColor: page.settings.viewBackgroundColor,
+          },
+          (width, height) => {
+            const scale = Math.min(
+              PAGE_PREVIEW_WIDTH / Math.max(width, 1),
+              PAGE_PREVIEW_HEIGHT / Math.max(height, 1),
+              1,
+            );
+            const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
+            canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(width * scale));
+            canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(height * scale));
+            return { canvas, scale };
+          },
+        )
+          .then((canvas) => {
+            if (active) {
+              setPreviewUrl(canvas.toDataURL());
+            }
+          })
+          .catch((error: unknown) => {
+            console.error("Failed to render page preview", error);
+          });
+      }, 250);
+
+      return () => {
+        active = false;
+        window.clearTimeout(timeout);
+      };
+    }, [appState, files, page]);
+
+    return previewUrl ? (
+      <img className="page-navigation__preview" src={previewUrl} alt="" />
+    ) : (
+      <span
+        className="page-navigation__preview page-navigation__preview--empty"
+        aria-hidden="true"
+      />
+    );
+  },
+  (prevProps, nextProps) =>
+    prevProps.page === nextProps.page &&
+    prevProps.files === nextProps.files &&
+    prevProps.appState.exportWithDarkMode ===
+      nextProps.appState.exportWithDarkMode &&
+    prevProps.appState.theme === nextProps.appState.theme,
+);
+
+export const Pages = ({
+  pages,
+  activePageId,
+  appState,
+  files,
+  onSelectPage,
+  onCreatePage,
+}: {
+  pages: readonly DrawingPage[];
+  activePageId: string;
+  appState: UIAppState;
+  files: BinaryFiles;
+  onSelectPage: (pageId: string) => void;
+  onCreatePage: () => void;
+}) => (
+  <div className="page-navigation" role="region" aria-label={t("labels.pages")}>
+    <div className="page-navigation__list">
+      {pages.map((page, index) => (
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          key={page.id}
+          className="page-navigation__item"
+          aria-label={`${t("labels.page")} ${index + 1}`}
+          aria-pressed={page.id === activePageId}
+          onClick={() => onSelectPage(page.id)}
+        >
+          <PagePreview page={page} files={files} appState={appState} />
+          <span className="page-navigation__item-title">
+            {t("labels.page")} {index + 1}
+          </span>
+        </button>
+      ))}
+    </div>
+    <button
+      type="button"
+      className="page-navigation__add"
+      onClick={onCreatePage}
+      disabled={appState.viewModeEnabled}
+    >
+      <span aria-hidden="true">+</span>
+      {t("buttons.addPage")}
+    </button>
+  </div>
+);
+
+export { PageIcon };

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";
+
+import { getDefaultAppState } from "./appState";
+
+import type { AppState } from "./types";
+
+export type PageSettings = Pick<
+  AppState,
+  | "viewBackgroundColor"
+  | "scrollX"
+  | "scrollY"
+  | "zoom"
+  | "gridSize"
+  | "gridStep"
+  | "gridScale"
+  | "gridSnapLinked"
+  | "gridSnapScale"
+  | "gridColor"
+  | "gridOpacity"
+  | "gridLayer"
+  | "gridModeEnabled"
+  | "gridSnapEnabled"
+  | "frameRendering"
+>;
+
+export type DrawingPage = Readonly<{
+  id: string;
+  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[];
+  settings: PageSettings;
+}>;
+
+export const getPageSettings = (appState: PageSettings): PageSettings => ({
+  viewBackgroundColor: appState.viewBackgroundColor,
+  scrollX: appState.scrollX,
+  scrollY: appState.scrollY,
+  zoom: appState.zoom,
+  gridSize: appState.gridSize,
+  gridStep: appState.gridStep,
+  gridScale: appState.gridScale,
+  gridSnapLinked: appState.gridSnapLinked,
+  gridSnapScale: appState.gridSnapScale,
+  gridColor: appState.gridColor,
+  gridOpacity: appState.gridOpacity,
+  gridLayer: appState.gridLayer,
+  gridModeEnabled: appState.gridModeEnabled,
+  gridSnapEnabled: appState.gridSnapEnabled,
+  frameRendering: appState.frameRendering,
+});
+
+export const createPage = (id: string): DrawingPage => ({
+  id,
+  elements: [],
+  settings: getPageSettings(getDefaultAppState()),
+});

+import React from "react";
+import { configure, fireEvent, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
+
+import "@excalidraw/utils/test-utils";
+
+import { DefaultSidebar, Excalidraw, Sidebar } from "../index";
+
+import { API } from "./helpers/api";
+import { render, unmountComponent } from "./test-utils";
+
+const { h } = window;
+
+configure({ asyncUtilTimeout: 5000 });
+
+describe("pages", () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    unmountComponent();
+    localStorage.clear();
+  });
+
+  it("creates pages and restores their elements, settings, and viewport", async () => {
+    const { getByRole, container } = await render(
+      <Excalidraw initialData={{ elements: [] }}>
+        <DefaultSidebar>
+          <DefaultSidebar.TabTriggers>
+            <Sidebar.TabTrigger tab="custom">Custom</Sidebar.TabTrigger>
+          </DefaultSidebar.TabTriggers>
+          <Sidebar.Tab tab="custom">Custom sidebar content</Sidebar.Tab>
+        </DefaultSidebar>
+      </Excalidraw>,
+    );
+    const element = API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id: "page-one" });
+
+    API.updateScene({ elements: [element] });
+    API.setAppState({
+      viewBackgroundColor: "#123456",
+      scrollX: 23,
+      scrollY: -11,
+    });
+
+    fireEvent.click(getByRole("button", { name: "Pages" }));
+    expect(getByRole("button", { name: "Page 1" })).toBeTruthy();
+    fireEvent.click(getByRole("button", { name: "Add page" }));
+
+    await waitFor(() => {
+      expect(h.elements).toHaveLength(0);
+    });
+    expect(h.state.viewBackgroundColor).not.toBe("#123456");
+    expect(h.state.scrollX).toBe(0);
+    expect(h.state.scrollY).toBe(0);
+    API.updateScene({
+      elements: [API.createElement({ type: "ellipse", id: "page-two" })],
+    });
+
+    fireEvent.click(getByRole("button", { name: "Page 1" }));
+    await waitFor(() => {
+      expect(h.elements).toHaveLength(1);
+    });
+    expect(h.elements[0].id).toBe("page-one");
+    expect(h.state.viewBackgroundColor).toBe("#123456");
+    expect(h.state.scrollX).toBe(23);
+    expect(h.state.scrollY).toBe(-11);
+    await waitFor(
+      () => {
+        expect(
+          container.querySelector("img.page-navigation__preview"),
+        ).not.toBeNull();
+      },
+      { timeout: 5000 },
+    );
+
+    fireEvent.click(getByRole("button", { name: "Page 2" }));
+    await waitFor(() => {
+      expect(h.elements).toHaveLength(1);
+    });
+    expect(h.elements[0].id).toBe("page-two");
+  });
+});
```

I stopped the old server on 3001. Yours is still running at http://localhost:3002. The PR's test passes (1/1). Short answers: you didn't miss any merge conflicts, but the tech-debt section shouldn't be empty, and two of the gaps can lose a user's drawings.

## Merge conflicts
There are none. The branch is one commit on top of current master (`46d92abb`), and a trial merge with master comes out clean.

One file in the diff doesn't belong there, though. [export.test.ts.snap](packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/__snapshots__/export.test.ts.snap) adds 135 lines for a snapshot called `exportToSvg > with a CJK font 2`. That test only takes one snapshot, so this is a leftover from a flaky full-suite run. It should be reverted from the PR.

## Tech debt the PR should list
Pages exist only in the editor's memory (`this.pages` in [App.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx)). Nothing outside the editor knows about them:

1. **Reloading loses pages.** The web app saves only the scene that's on screen. After a reload, every page except the one you were on is gone, and that one shows up as "Page 1". This is the big one.
2. **Saving to file and exporting only cover the current page.** A `.excalidraw` file holds just one page.
3. **Collaboration mixes pages together.** When someone switches pages, the new page is sent to everyone else and merged into their canvas, and later syncs send it back. In a shared session, pages will bleed into each other. I worked this out from how syncing combines elements; I didn't test it live.
4. **Images on other pages can be deleted.** The web app regularly clears out stored image files that aren't used on the canvas ([LocalData.ts:54](excalidraw-app/data/LocalData.ts#L54)). Images that are only on a page you're not viewing count as unused, so they can be removed after about a day.
5. **Switching pages clears undo history** (`history.clear()`). That's probably on purpose, but the PR should say so.
6. **"Reset the canvas" and loading a file only affect the current page.** The other pages stay.
7. **The current page's thumbnail redraws constantly.** `getPagesForUI` builds a new object for that page on every render, so its preview re-renders 250ms after any change, including scrolling and panning.
8. **Pages can be switched in view mode now.** The Pages button was moved outside the view-mode check. Adding pages is still disabled there; switching isn't.
9. **Missing features:** you can't delete, rename or reorder pages.

## Gradients, motion, masking
I didn't find anything you missed.
- **Masking:** if you're in masking mode and switch pages, the editor closes itself because the mask isn't on the new page ([App.tsx:3939](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx#L3939)).
- **Motion:** switching clears the selection, which ends motion-path editing. Its undo step only touches elements already on the current page, so a path from page 1 can't appear on page 2.
- **Gradients and images:** these are stored on the elements themselves, so they move with each page. Thumbnails are drawn with the same code as image export.

One small gap: the page-switch reset doesn't clear crop mode (`croppingElementId` / `isCropping`). If you switch pages while cropping an image, crop mode may stay on with no image. Worth a quick manual try.

I only ran the new pages test, not the full suite, and I checked items 3 and 4 by reading the code, not by running them.

## The snapshot file
[export.test.ts.snap](packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/__snapshots__/export.test.ts.snap) holds the saved output of the SVG export tests. Each test calls `toMatchSnapshot()`, and Vitest compares the result with the saved copy.

Snapshot names get a counter: the first `toMatchSnapshot()` call in a test is saved as `... 1`, the second as `... 2`. The `with a CJK font` test calls it only once, so it should only ever have a `1`. The PR adds a `with a CJK font 2` entry, which no test produces. It's most likely what you already saved to memory: a full `yarn test:update` run where that test timed out and was retried, so the snapshot got written a second time.

It doesn't break anything. Vitest will just flag it as obsolete. It still has nothing to do with pages and shouldn't be merged. Ask the author to drop it with `git checkout origin/master -- packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/__snapshots__/export.test.ts.snap`.

## How to crop
1. Put an image on the canvas by dragging a file in or using the image tool.
2. Select it, then **double-click** it or press **Enter**. Right-click → **Crop image** works too.
3. Drag the handles to crop.
4. Press **Enter** or **Esc**, or click away, to finish.

To test the page bug, start cropping an image (step 2), open the Pages sidebar, and click **Add page** or another page. Then see whether crop mode is still on in the new page.
